howItWorks.heading: What your child's summer session actually looks like
howItWorks.subheading: GrowWise academic summer programs are structured academic sprints — not full-day camps. Each visit gives your child teacher-led instruction, guided practice, and a clear path toward fall readiness in reading, writing, or math.
howItWorks.stepsAriaLabel: Four steps in every GrowWise academic summer session

steps.title: Focused instruction with a teacher
steps.parentLine: Your child learns the concept—not just receives a worksheet.
steps.detail: A subject-trained instructor reviews the skill, models examples, and works through problems with the group so gaps surface while support is still available.

steps.title: Guided practice lab included
steps.parentLine: Practice happens before they leave—not at the kitchen table alone.
steps.detail: Students apply what they just learned while the teacher is still in the room. That means fewer "I didn't understand the homework" moments at home.

steps.title: Small-group support (max 8)
steps.parentLine: Small enough to ask questions. Structured enough to stay on task.
steps.detail: Up to 8 students per class—more attention than a crowded classroom, more engagement than one-on-one tutoring marathons.

steps.title: DUSD & PUSD-aligned skill targets
steps.parentLine: Summer work connects to what DUSD and PUSD classrooms expect in fall.
steps.detail: Sessions build toward Dublin Unified and Pleasanton Unified standards in reading, writing, and math—so your child's summer practice matches the skills they'll see when school starts again.

reviews.quote: We've had a great experience with GrowWise so far. My son attends both English and Math tuition here, and we've seen noticeable progress, especially in his writing skills. The Math program has really helped him focus—the tutor works through problems patiently, assigns homework, and reviews it thoroughly. For English, they've been following the 3rd grade curriculum, and I've seen real improvement in his writing and expression. We recommend GrowWise for anyone looking for quality academic support in a caring environment!

My son has been enrolled in English tutoring for the past four months, and we've seen tremendous improvement in his skills! His confidence in writing has grown, and his comprehension has improved significantly. The tutors are patient, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to helping students succeed. The personalized approach and engaging lessons have made a huge difference. Highly recommend GrowWise for any parent looking to support their child's academic growth!

The GrowWise team engaged the kids in a great way. I enrolled my daughter in reading club for spring break—she had a great time and learnt so many new words through word search activities she loved. The kids were enjoying the session. Thank you GrowWise team for this opportunity given to all the small ones!
reviews.byline: — Saranya Bosch · 5★ Google review · Local Guide
